result.markdown:
For most small teams, **I'd recommend HubSpot CRM as the best overall CRM.** It's relatively easy to learn, has a strong free version, and can grow with your business.

However, the best choice depends on how your team handles sales, customers, and follow-ups.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

![HubSpot + Outbound Best Practices: How to Build a Predictable Pipeline Engine](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fRaXjaIhlPuB-R-vp4pPeoGZlftvdgXSxyn6Q2rF42Kvv67ncid10g7lK3I8Ts0KBOUtWU1e_TFh69Ct3Yd7iXz5hetANX31x3M_throOc-8gj_ptcYrP0lMRBY1bi8qNHq1cblhhZaZ0YHkqql9Vi2haPe6jLaATcrIrrFWSWPloM1A0RgNH3M1Ze3FRXoV?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot**

(Best overall)

- Great free CRM to get started
- Contact management, deals, tasks and email tracking
- Sales, marketing and customer service in one ecosystem

Best for teams wanting an all-in-one solution.

[Explore HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![Pipedrive Culture | Comparably](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LL0qs5ZEn5bajHXZMpCmlJ4Q8G8bG-uCRPdMDaugOTZ5M83xr5SdfSJtpaTsU9pV5XZU_j6tdK98aLeb5eQtmf3jAulEyqWXtwu_NCqqantmt4RgTKgW92e5jqAqiwI5Gvz6HoJSFRLf0DV2WCKF0F5we1qdhyYgERFOvFPWSwO__wWT47lukE3R9cSOeuBr?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Excellent visual sales pipeline
- Easy to track leads and deals
- Strong sales activity and follow-up management

Best for teams focused on closing more deals.

[Explore Pipedrive](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![TheProwess | Zoho CRM'de Yeni Dönem: Eski Arayüz 15 Temmuz'da Tamamen Kaldırılıyor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mhOzD_IXTeMyjegHs7_31H-nZlvGoIQWY2PfiTmHpwuQOA09A9NutmTAM8TWT2HF-7JryptkgV-lS_xHcaI7d43ujbBUTvqfxj-z3nk-gdRQr3-Ei-qigHIPik-T14ytWC4EuYLl0he93dU9qCw5sHTS1LPdprZuUjTWv0UHX5wzcmxSTdtKBrPPwq-xdGBE?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

- Excellent value for money
- Customizable workflows and automation
- Free plan for up to three users

Best for budget-conscious teams wanting flexibility.

[Explore Zoho CRM](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Descargar Freshsales CRM varies-with-device para Web Apps - Filehippo.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ymGWkXtkAC7MoWysGML3OKgHF9O0MPKH1PfAAeDjk1aaZrRWaVBb9r5y-Kf_8j4xYqKU0KB7QvzLaYT0HE0Vv7VVhtrsyXiqQzkmNrQWCEXFxliHIByLJsgnf2ztG74VQ6KpL_qyhXQE--CUkaD3WIbFGDInuBn5hMKNEjmTwahJ5xR1Qf4y9c43huoiOovk?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Built-in email, phone and chat capabilities
- Lead scoring and automation
- Affordable entry-level paid plan

Best for teams that communicate with prospects frequently.

[Explore Freshsales](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![Press | Less Annoying CRM](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2qatplq6csyuUFkgeu64DSNLeY1k3cfYZWtzzFx81-c9TcZwWoUySRvz6Fs_wbvTDD91lMvffHRk9HGZjKJwM802Tzpg6G1lsG_WO2SDnAIYdxUaCBlEmMtjHt5udyeu9XPFQM7DZtURs4rTvF4j6_iAo16T_2yOMKSVsb9SbIreD6LNJw75WslzAFEEf8mP?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Less Annoying CRM**

- Very simple interface
- Minimal learning curve
- Straightforward pricing

Best for very small teams that don't need complicated features.

[Explore Less Annoying CRM](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/)

## Quick comparison

Approximate starting prices in USD, per user/month, generally with annual billing.

| CRM | Starting price | Best for |
|--------|--------|--------|
| HubSpot | Free | Overall |
| Pipedrive | \$14 | Sales pipeline |
| Zoho | \$14 | Value |
| Freshsales | \$9 | Sales communication |
| Less Annoying CRM | \$15 | Simplicity |


Prices and plan limits can change.
